name: A Biting Thirst
description: "Mauro near a cave entrance tried to fetch water from a small pond inside, but some snakes bit him until he spilled and drank what little remained.

name: A Drop of Relief
description: Nathan is stationed outside the Sandstorm Mines and suffering under the blazing heat. He doesn't need water to drink, just a bottle to pour over himself.

name: A Miner's Helping Hand
description: Naem, one of the workers in the Sandstorm Mines, offered you a spare mining helmet to keep you safe as you venture deeper.

name: An Old Friendship
description: Frost, a man sitting on a bench in Tulimshar, asks you to retrieve old letters from the castle corridor. Stay in the shadows to avoid the guards.

name: Desert Seed
description: Deep in the Sandstorm Mines, you discovered a living Mana Tree and recovered its Kano, a rare Mana Seed.

name: Elanore's Potions
description: Elanore needs ingredients to brew healing potions. Bring her six Maggot Slimes, one Water and one Pitaya.
target: Maggot Slime x6, Water x1, Pitaya x1

name: Found a Chest in the Outskirts
description: Found a chest in the Tulimshar eastern outskirts.

name: Grain in the desert
description: Riskim the baker is waiting for a grain shipment marked with a blue Artis seal. Check the barrels at the docks.

name: Mine Exploration
description: Scout the Sandstorm Mines and ensure the cave system is clear of major dangers before the miners move in.

name: Nina's Snack
description: Nina is hungry but too dedicated to leave her post. Find her a croissant from the market.

name: Peter's Bounty
description: A sailor aboard the ship is offering bounty contracts to clear rattos from the ship's hold.

name: Sandstorm Mine Abandoned Treasure
description: "A rusty key lies hidden in the depths of the abandoned mine

name: Snake Pit Thief
description: Investigate a hidden bedroom deep within the Snake Pit, uncover the fate of a Tulimshar thief, solve his riddle, and recover the treasure he never reclaimed.

name: Splatyna's Offering
description: "Bicies waits at the cave entrance, obsessed with a giant slime named Splatyna. He says she loves gold and keeps the corruption away.

name: Tutorial
description: Get settled in Tulimshar with Elanore's help.

name: Veteran Cave Explorer
description: For those who once walked these lands before the world was reborn.

name: When the desert gives you sand...
description: Eridu the glassmaker makes very useful glass bottles. He will exchange some bottles for salt, bones and sulphur powder gathered in the desert.
target: Salt x12, Bone x12, Sulphur Powder x12
